_note: Transcription of the exact Railway Template Composer settings for the MySQL 9.7 LTS template. Railway does NOT read this file automatically — enter these settings in the Template Composer when publishing, and check the published page against this file. Reference variable values are set by the Template Composer at publish time; verify them against the published page.
category_note: Railway's category list has no 'Database' option (checked 2026-11-03); Storage is the closest available filing.
description: Single-node MySQL 9.7 LTS database, ready to deploy
name: MySQL 9.7 LTS
notIncluded: Backups (snapshot the volume or run mysqldump on a schedule)

healthcheck.note: Database services have no HTTP healthcheck path. Health is proven by an authenticated mysqladmin ping / mysql client connection, as in scripts/local-test.sh — not by process liveness alone.

MYSQL_DATABASE.note: Optional. Created on first start when set; leave unset for a bare server.

MYSQL_PASSWORD.note: Optional app user password. Never ship a real value in this repo.

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.note: Never ship a real value in this repo.

MYSQL_URL.note: Railway reference variable for other services in the same project.

MYSQL_USER.note: Optional. Created on first start only when MYSQL_PASSWORD is also set.

volumes.note: Persistent volume. Without it, data is lost on redeploy.

stillUntestedAtPublish: Live Railway deploy of this template (waits for a paid Railway plan to be active)
